subject: Order Form: Subprocessor consent & MSA redline clarifications
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@astracloud.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@astracloud.com
Date: Tue, 08 Apr 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Order Form + subprocessor consent — request

Hi Laura / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move to PO on the attached Order Form (v3 redline) but need to confirm Redwood's acceptance of one additional subprocessor used for telemetry/metrics: LogStream Ltd. (they will receive application-level metrics and IP addresses for routing).

Per AstraCloud's procurement checklist, we need:
- written confirmation that Redwood will flow down DPA obligations to LogStream (or that AstraCloud's DPA will be satisfied by contract with Redwood),
- a copy of LogStream's SOC 2 report OR a signed DPA annex from LogStream,
- a 30-day notification window for any subsequent subprocessor changes (Astra standard),
- confirmation whether Redwood will allow a DocuSign flow for subprocessor consent or expects a separate legal amendment.

Attaching: Astra_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf (PDF, 42 KB) that includes the new order form language and a highlighted subproc clause. Can you confirm by EOD Friday 4/11 whether Redwood can accept LogStream under the flow-down terms, and if you need additional evidence? Our procurement team is on a tight timeline to get the PO executed next week.

Elena
Elena Morales
Sr. Procurement Manager | AstraCloud Inc.
Attachment: Astra_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@astracloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Apr 2025 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form + subprocessor consent — request

Elena — thanks for the order form and the heads up. We're generally fine with telemetry subprocessors but need to validate a couple of items before we can sign-off.

Quick summary of Redwood's requirements for onboarding a new subprocessor (how we'll evaluate LogStream):
- DPA flow-down: Redwood must ensure contractual commitments equivalent to the Astra DPA are flowed to LogStream (security, data handling, breach notification timelines). If LogStream will sign a DPA annex directly with Astra, that's acceptable but we need a copy.
- Evidence: current SOC 2 Type II (or equivalent audit) from LogStream, and the name and contact of their security lead.
- Scope & data exposure: we need a one-paragraph description of what telemetry is shared (PII vs. pseudonymous IPs) and retention windows.
- Operational control: if LogStream will process customer-identifiable logs, we may require a service-level carve-out in the Order Form limiting retention and providing audit rights.

I've attached internal review notes (Redwood_subproc_review_notes_20250409.docx) with a proposed minor redline to the Order Form: explicit DPA flow-down language and a 30-day notification requirement for downstream changes.

Proposed timeline: if Astra can provide LogStream's SOC2 and the signed annex by 4/10 EOD, Kimberly's team can approve the subproc clause and we can proceed with DocuSign the same week. If evidence is staggered, we may need a conditional sign-off (PO contingent on receiving the SOC2 within 7 days).

I'll loop in Kimberly formally — her legal review will be the gating item.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Product Counsel | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_subproc_review_notes_20250409.docx (DOCX, 18 KB)

Hi all — looping in legal/contract to confirm the items Laura flagged. Appreciate Astra and LogStream providing the SOC2 and contact details. Two points from our side:

1) Draft clause: I've prepared a short clause to embed in the Order Form and MSA referencing flow-down of data protection obligations to subprocessors and a 30-day notification window for new subprocessors. See attached (subproc_clause_draft.txt). We prefer to keep notice at 30 days to align with our internal tracking; deviating to a shorter notice would require an exception.

2) Signatory flow: Redwood can accept a DocuSign flow where LogStream signs a DPA annex; however, Redwood legal requires that the annex either be signed by LogStream and countersigned by Astra or be signed by LogStream with a copy delivered to Redwood prior to PO issuance. In short: we need the executed DPA annex on file.

3) Conditional PO path: if Astra needs the PO to be issued before LogStream executes the annex, we can support a conditional PO that states: "PO issued subject to receipt of executed DPA annex and SOC2 within 7 calendar days." Procurement should confirm if a conditional PO meets your accounting requirements.

Next steps I propose:
- Astra confirms whether LogStream will sign directly with Astra or whether Turndown expects LogStream->Redwood signing.
- Astra shares the executed annex OR we proceed with conditional PO language.
- Connor / Markus: can you confirm operational limits (retention enforcement and audit rights) are feasible if we accept LogStream? Connor, Markus — please reply with any hard stops.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
Attachment: subproc_clause_draft.txt (TXT, 3 KB)

Elena — thank you for the SOC2 and details. To close this out and keep Astra on your PO timeline, here are the final asks and our preferred path: 

1) Evidence & annex: please have LogStream execute the DPA annex. Astra can countersign or deliver the fully-executed annex to Redwood. We need the executed annex and the SOC2 on file prior to final Redwood countersign. If Astra needs the PO earlier, Redwood can issue a conditional PO with the following language: 

   "Purchase Order is issued subject to Redwood receiving an executed DPA annex from LogStream and delivery of the LogStream SOC2 Type II report within seven (7) calendar days of PO date."

2) Order Form language: Kimberly's draft clause is acceptable to us — we'll add it to the Order Form v3 before countersign. If Astra prefers to keep the 30-day notification window, that's fine; we will mirror it.

3) Operational: Connor and Markus — please confirm there are no technical blockers to enforcing retention limits at the LogStream integration layer. If there are, flag them now so we can scope a short statement of work change.

If Astra can provide the executed annex by Monday 4/14, Kimberly will clear the final redline and we can circulate DocuSign Monday/Tuesday to keep your PO timeline. If not, we'll issue the conditional PO language and proceed with the 7-day evidence requirement.

Thanks for moving quickly on this. Elena, once you confirm the annex route we'll prepare the redlined Order Form and DocuSign packet.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Product Counsel | Redwood Inference
